title: Wreck and Compass
author: Mirabel Dravenmoor
blurb: Jonah Winterbourne, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
